blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Weight pruning can degrade the accuracy of large reasoning models (LRMs), yet it remains unclear whether it damages reasoning itself. We find that much of this degradation stems from a failure to stop rather than to reason. As sparsity increases, pruned LRMs increasingly fail to terminate within the token budget, often after the correct answer has appeared in their reasoning, instead falling into repetitive loops, even though they still recognize where the dense model would stop. We further find that the hidden-state difference between terminating and looping continuations is consistent across pruned checkpoints, suggesting a shared direction associated with committing to an answer. Building on this, we propose Termination-Guided Activation Steering (TGAS), a training-free method that adds this direction to the residual stream at inference time. Across six LRMs, three pruning pipelines, and math and code benchmarks, TGAS improves termination and overall accuracy while reducing repetitive reasoning and generation length, showing that this failure is actionable.
blocks.zh: 重量推算可以降低大型推理模型(LRMs)的准确性,但尚不清楚它是否损害推理本身. 我们认为,这种退化在很大程度上是由于未能停止而不是理智。 随着螺旋性增强,被挤压的LRM在符號預算中越来越不能终止,常常是在他们的推理中出现了正确的答案后,反而陷入了重复循环,尽管他们仍然认识到密集模型会停止在哪里. 我们进一步发现,终止和环绕持续之间的隐蔽状态差异在被查封的检查站之间是一致的,这表明与承诺解决问题有关的共同方向。 在此基础上,我们提出 " 终止指导启动指导 " (TGAS),这是一种无培训方法,在推断时将这一方向添加到剩余流中。 通过6个LRM,3个螺旋管,以及数学和代码基准,TGAS改进了终止和整体准确性,同时减少了重复推理和生成长度,表明这种失败是可以行动的.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by generating long chain-of-thought traces, but this makes inference expensive ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . Weight pruning offers a natural approach to reduce cost by zeroing out selected parameters ( Frantar and Alistarh, 2023 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . However, as consistently observed across pruning methods, pruning LRMs can substantially degrade accuracy on reasoning tasks ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Lucas et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Existing efforts have primarily focused on mitigating this degradation through improved pruning calibration ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Lucas et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , alongside post-pruning recovery via retraining or fine-tuning ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Muralidharan et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024a ) . Yet, it remains unclear whether this degradation reflects a loss of reasoning capability or a different kind of failure.
blocks.zh: 大型推理模型(LRMs)通过产生长期的思维链痕来达到强效,但这使得推论成本昂贵(Zhang等,2026a; 郭等, 2025 (中文(简体) ). 重量计算提供了一种自然方法,通过对选定的参数进行零化来降低成本(Frantar and Alistarh, 2023;Sun等人, 2024)。 然而,正如在各种推倒方法中一致观察到的,推倒LRM在推理任务上可以大幅度地降低准确性(Ji等,2025;Lucas等,2026;Zhang等,2026b.). 现有工作主要侧重于通过改进分流校正来缓解这种退化(Ji等人,2025年;Lucas等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年b),同时通过再培训和微调进行分流后恢复(Liu等人,2025年b;Muralidharan等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年;Xia等人,2024年a)。 然而,这种退化是否反映了推理能力的丧失,还是另一种失败,尚不清楚。

blocks.en: We find that much of this degradation stems from a failure to stop rather than a failure to reason . As sparsity increases, pruned LRMs increasingly fail to terminate and commit to a final answer within the token budget, and accuracy falls accordingly (Figure 1 ). Strikingly, many of these non-terminating traces already contain the correct answer, yet the model keeps reasoning until the budget is exhausted. We refer to this behavior as reasoning divergence . On problems solved by the dense model, pruned models remain largely accurate whenever they terminate, and non-termination becomes the dominant source of errors as sparsity grows (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们发现,这种退化在很大程度上是由于未能制止而不是缺乏理智。 随着螺旋性增加,螺旋状的LRM越来越不能终止并承诺在象征性预算范围内作出最后答复,准确性也相应下降(图1 )。 令人惊奇的是,许多这些非终结性的痕迹已经包含了正确的答案,而模型却保持了推理直到预算用完. 我们把这种行为称为推理分歧。 在密集模型所解决的问题上,被磨损的模型在终止时基本保持准确性,而随着孢子增加,不终止则成为主要出错来源(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: Why do pruned models fail to stop? Pruning does not erase the stopping signal: when replaying dense traces, pruned models still assign high probability to the end-of-thinking token where the dense model stops. Instead, during free-running generation they increasingly revisit earlier reasoning rather than moving forward, and fall into repetitive loops. Moreover, the hidden-state difference between continuations that terminate and those that loop points in a similar direction across pruned checkpoints, suggesting that the shift between looping and committing to an answer is captured by a shared direction in representation space.
blocks.zh: 为甚么被打倒的模特们都停了? Pruning不会去除停止信号:当重放稠密的痕迹时,被pruned models仍然会给稠密的模型所停止的思维结束的符号分配出高概率. 相反,在自由经营的一代人中,他们越来越多地重新审视早先的推理,而不是向前走,陷入了重复循环。 此外,终止的延续与跨越被查封的检查站的循环指向类似方向的延续之间的隐藏状态差异,表明在循环与承诺答案之间的转变是通过代表空间的共同方向来体现的。

blocks.en: Based on this diagnosis, we propose Termination-Guided Activation Steering (TGAS), which adds this direction to the residual stream at inference time to steer pruned models toward termination without retraining or weight updates. TGAS consistently improves termination and accuracy across six LRMs, three pruning pipelines, and math and code benchmarks by reducing repetitive reasoning. Our contributions are threefold: (i) We show that a substantial part of pruning-induced degradation in LRMs arises from reasoning divergence, a failure to commit rather than a loss of reasoning ability; (ii) We identify a hidden-state direction that separates terminating from looping continuations, and build on it TGAS, a training-free steering method; (iii) We show that TGAS consistently improves termination and overall accuracy across models, pruning methods, and benchmarks by reducing looping.
blocks.zh: 基于这一诊断,我们提议采用 " 终止指导激活指导 " (TGAS),在推断时间将这一方向添加到剩余流中,以引导被扭曲的模型在没有再培训和体重更新的情况下走向终止。 TGAS通过减少重复推理,不断改进6个LRM、3个管道的终止和准确性以及数学和代码基准。 我们的贡献有三个方面:(一) 我们显示,在LRM中,大量由挤压引起的降解是由于推理分歧、未能承诺而不是丧失推理能力;(二) 我们确定一个隐藏状态方向,将终止循环延续与循环延续区分开来,并在这一方向上以TGAS为基础,一种没有培训的指导方法;(三) 我们显示,TGAS通过减少循环,不断提高终止和跨模型、循环方法和基准的总体准确性。

blocks.en: LRMs can overthink and enter repetitive loops ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Pipis et al., 2026 ) , which quantization can further prolong ( Lotfi et al., 2026 ) . We show that pruning amplifies looping while largely preserving the stopping signal, distinguishing failures to stop from failures to reason. Activation steering offers a way to modify behavior by adding directions to the residual stream, with difference-in-means directions shown to control behaviors of LLMs ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) . For reasoning, SEAL ( Chen et al., 2025 ) suppresses reflection, while Plan-CoT ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) modulates reasoning length. In contrast, TGAS targets pruning-induced non-termination using contrasting continuations of the same prefix, yielding a direction weakly aligned with SEAL’s (Appendix F.8 ).
blocks.zh: LRM可以过度思考并进入重复循环(Chen等,2026;Pipis等,2026),再量化可以进一步延长(Lotfi等,2026). 我们显示,螺旋式会放大回路,同时基本上保留了停止信号,区分了停止失败和理性。 活性向导通过给剩余流添加方向来提供一种改变行为的方法,其中显示的区别指向可以控制LLMS的行为(Arditi等,2024年). 对于推理,SEAL(Chen等,2025年)压制了反射,而Plan-CoT(Sheng等,2025年)则调节了推理长度. 相比之下,TGAS的目标是利用同一前缀的对比续作来进行由推倒引起的不终止,从而产生一个与海豹突击队相对应的方向(附录F.8)。

blocks.en: 3 Understanding Pruning-Induced Reasoning Degradation
blocks.zh: 3 理解诱导的退化

blocks.en: We investigate three questions: (i) Do pruned models lose reasoning ability or only the ability to stop? (ii) Is non-termination caused by limited generation budgets? (iii) Why do models fail to stop despite reaching the correct answer? We address the first two questions in Section 3.1 and the third in Section 3.2 . Recall that we refer to this phenomenon as reasoning divergence , characterized by non-termination , driven by repetitive looping and an failure to commit to final answers.
blocks.zh: 我们调查三个问题: (一)被打压的模型是否失去推理能力,还是只有停止的能力? (二) 有限发电预算是否造成不终止? (三)为什么模型虽然得到了正确的答案却未能停止? 我们处理第3.1节的头两个问题,第3.2节的第三个问题。 回顾我们把这一现象称为推理分歧,其特征是:不终止、反复循环和不承诺最后答案。

blocks.en: Setting. We evaluate DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen (DS-Qwen), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama (DS-Llama) ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , and OpenThinker3 (OT3) ( Guha et al., 2026 ) under one-shot unstructured pruning of decoder linear layers at varying sparsity levels, using SparseGPT or Wanda with OBC, RAC, or C4 calibration. Benchmarks include MATH-500 Levels 4-5 (hereafter MATH-500) ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , AIME-25 ( Zhang and Math-AI, 2025 ) , and LiveCodeBench-v6 (LCB) ( Jain et al., 2025 ) ; OpenR1-Math-220K (OpenR1-Math) ( Hugging Face, 2025 ) is used only for calibration and steering-direction construction. We use a 16,384-token budget, T = 0.6 T=0.6 , and top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , averaging k = 4 k=4 responses on three benchmarks. Our default uses SparseGPT with OBC calibration on model-generated reasoning traces, counting a response as correct only if it commits to a final answer, detailed in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 3.1 Do Pruned Models Lose the Ability to Reason?
blocks.zh: 3.1 运行模式 失去理性的能力吗?

blocks.en: To determine whether reasoning divergence reflects a loss of reasoning capability, we evaluate pruned models on problems correctly solved by their dense counterparts. Table 1 shows that as sparsity grows, the additional errors come mainly from non-termination rather than from incorrect answers. On MATH-500, going from 50% to 60% sparsity raises the non-termination rate from 3.8% to 16.8% for DS-Qwen-7B, and from 2.4% to 16.4% for the 14B counterpart, while the terminated-but-wrong rate stays nearly unchanged. Terminated generations largely preserve their accuracy at high sparsity, despite fewer dense-correct samples remaining correct. These results suggest that substantial reasoning capability remains intact under moderate pruning, while termination becomes the primary bottleneck as sparsity grows (full results in Appendix D.1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了确定推理差异是否反映了推理能力的丧失,我们评价了由它们密集的对应方正确解决的被扭曲的模型. 表1显示,随着痉挛性的增长,额外的出错主要出自于不终止而非错误的答案. 在MATH-500上,从50%到60%的垃圾邮件将DS-Quen-7B的非终止率从3.8%提高到16.8%,14B对应方从2.4%提高到16.4%,而终止但错误的比率则几乎保持不变。 被终止的几代人基本上保持了高度痉挛状态的准确性,尽管保持正确性的密集样本较少。 这些结果显示,在中度挤压下,实质性的推理能力仍然完好无损,而终止则会随着痉挛性的增长而成为主要瓶颈(附录D.1中的全部结果)。

blocks.en: We ask whether reasoning divergence is simply caused by an insufficient generation budget. As shown in Figure 3 , increasing the budget from 16,384 to 65,536 tokens substantially reduces non-termination at low and moderate sparsity, e.g., from 42.5% to 12.5% for 7B at 50% sparsity, but leaves accuracy nearly unchanged for DS-Qwen 7B and 14B, while at 60–70% sparsity non-termination barely decreases. Appendix D.2 shows that the larger budget recovers only 0–3 additional correct traces across settings, suggesting that pruning-induced failures are not primarily due to insufficient generation length.
blocks.zh: 我们问,推理上的分歧是否仅仅是因为预算不足造成的。 如图3所示,将预算从16,384个增加到65,536个令牌,大大降低了中低度和中度的不终止,例如从42.5%降至12.5%,7B为50%,但DS-Quen 7B和14B的准确性几乎保持不变,而60-70%的不终止则几乎不会下降。 附录D.2显示,较大的预算只恢复了0至3个不同的环境,这表明,挤压引起的故障主要不是因为生成时间不足。

blocks.en: Since a larger budget rarely helps, we next ask what the non-terminating traces contain: does the reasoning already reach the correct answer even when the model fails to terminate and finalize it? To answer this question, we use text-based rules, termed Conclusive , that detect answer-like statements following cues such as "thus the answer" or "so we get" (Appendix C.2 ). 1 1 1 We validate Conclusive against an independent LLM judge: on 250 sampled traces, the two agree on 96.0% of cases ( κ = 0.898 \kappa=0.898 ; Appendix C.3 ). Figure 2 shows that a substantial fraction of non-terminating traces already contain the correct answer: at 60% sparsity, this holds for 41.4 % 41.4\% and 39.2 % 39.2\% of non-terminating traces for DS-Qwen 7B and 14B, respectively, with the answer appearing early at a median of 13.0 % 13.0\% and 11.9 % 11.9\% of the trace length, roughly 2.1k and 1.9k tokens. Despite reaching the correct answer, models continue generating to the token limit, often entering repetitive or corrective reasoning. This suggests that non-termination often reflects reasoning divergence rather than an inability to reach the correct answer. We provide a headroom analysis in Appendix E.3 , quantifying the recoverable accuracy loss by counting non-terminating traces that already contain the correct answer as correct.
blocks.zh: 由于预算增加很少有帮助,我们接下来要问的是,没有终结的痕迹包含什么:即使模型未能终止并最后确定,推理是否已经达到正确的答案? 为了回答这个问题,我们使用以文字为基础的规则,称为结论(Constructionive ),在诸如“因此我们得到答案”或“所以我们得到”等提示之后检测到类似答案的声明(附录C.2 )。 图2显示,很大一部分非终止痕迹已包含正确答案:在60%的垃圾堆中,DS-Quen 7B和14B的未终止痕迹分别占41.4%、41.4%和39.2%,而答案早期的中位数为13.0%、13.0%和11.9%;微量长度约为2.1克和1.9克。 尽管得到了正确的答案,模型仍然继续生成到象征性的极限,经常进入重复或纠正的推理. 这表明,不终止常常反映推理上的分歧,而不是无法得出正确的答案. 我们在附录E.3中提供了头室分析,通过计算已经包含正确答案的不终止痕迹,量化可收回的准确性损失。

blocks.en: 3.2 Why Do Pruned Models Fail to Terminate?
blocks.zh: 3.2 为何Pruned Models未能终止?

blocks.en: Section 3.1 shows that pruned LRMs largely retain the ability to reach correct answers but increasingly fail to terminate. We show that the stopping signal remains intact, yet during free-running generation, models struggle to commit to final answers and fall into repetitive reasoning loops.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节显示,经调整的LRM在很大程度上保留了获得正确答案的能力,但越来越未能终止。 我们显示,停止信号仍然完好无损,然而在自由运行的一代中,模型挣扎着致力于最终答案并陷入重复推理循环.

blocks.en: We test whether pruning impairs stopping recognition via teacher forcing. Let 𝒟 cov \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{cov}} denote dense traces that terminate correctly. We replay these traces through each pruned checkpoint and measure p ⁡ ( </think> ) p(\texttt{</think>}{}) and its rank at the dense model’s termination position ( STOP ). As shown in Table 2 , at 50–60% sparsity, the signal remains strong: for 7B, p ⁡ ( </think> ) > 0.92 p(\texttt{</think>}{})>0.92 with median rank 0 on both AIME-25 and MATH-500, while 14B exceeds 0.85 0.85 with the same rank. At 70%, it drops to 0.036 0.036 – 0.040 0.040 for 7B and 0.073 0.073 – 0.130 0.130 for 14B. Comparing STOP with positions more than 50 tokens earlier, we find that </think> remains substantially more likely at STOP at all sparsities, but at 70% its log-probability falls below that of the ordinarily generated tokens, detailed in Appendix D.3 . Thus, the stopping signal remains largely intact under moderate pruning, suggesting that the main failure is reaching, rather than recognizing, the stopping point. At 70% sparsity, the signal remains localized but weakens, consistent with severe pruning also impairing stopping recognition.

We label each paragraph Cyclic if its 8-word n-gram set has Jaccard similarity ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 with any earlier paragraph in the same trace, and Progress otherwise, following Pipis et al. (2026) , as illustrated in Figure 4 .

blocks.en: The preceding analysis shows that pruning shifts model behavior toward repetitive loops rather than progressing new reasoning steps. We next examine how pruned models continue dense reasoning traces. Following Section 3.1 , we revisit the Conclusive point. For each trace, we define the branch point b b as the first eligible paragraph start after Conclusive such that the prefix 𝐱 < b \mathbf{x}_{<b} is sufficient to identify the correct answer. We teacher-force the prefix through the pruned checkpoint and sample N N continuations, discarding traces without eligible branch points. Thus, continuations share the same prefix, checkpoint, and problem, differing only beyond the branch point.

blocks.en: 4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: If looping reflects a failure to commit rather than a loss of capability, a pruned model should be steerable toward committing without weight updates. We use a hidden-state direction that separates terminating from looping continuations under the same prefix.
blocks.zh: 如果循环反映的是未作出承诺,而不是能力丧失,那么一个被扭曲的模型应该能够在没有重量更新的情况下致力于承诺。 我们使用隐藏状态方向,将终止和在同一前缀下循环续作区分开来.

blocks.en: 4.2 Direction Consistency Across Checkpoints
blocks.zh: 4.2 各个检查站的一贯性

blocks.en: Figure 5 reports sim ⁡ ( A , B ) \mathrm{sim}(A,B) between directions from different pruning levels of the same model, and shows that they are highly consistent. For DS-Qwen-7B on MATH-500, the cosine similarity between directions from 50–70% pruning ratios remains at least 0.87 0.87 ; for DS-Qwen-1.5B, directions from 40–60% have pairwise cosine similarities of at least 0.83 0.83 (sample counts and results on OpenR1-Math are in Appendix C.4.5 ). These results suggest that the difference between repetitive reasoning and commitment is represented in a relatively stable direction in hidden-state space rather than being specific to an individual pruning checkpoint, enabling a single direction per model to generalize across sparsity levels. Appendix D.5 shows that this similarity is not an artifact of comparing checkpoints of the same model: across 15 checkpoint pairs, it exceeds both a label-shuffled baseline and a shared contrast unrelated to commitment in every pair.

blocks.en: 4.3 Steering at Inference
blocks.zh: 4.3 推论指导

blocks.en: TGAS constructs the direction at an intermediate sparsity level, where both 𝒞 b + \mathcal{C}^{+}_{b} and 𝒞 b − \mathcal{C}^{-}_{b} contain enough trajectories, and reuses it for all sparsity levels of the same model. We select the steering layer ℓ ⋆ \ell^{\star} on held-out branch points as the layer whose direction best separates the two classes (highest ROC AUC of the projection; Appendix C.4.5 ). The steering vector is this direction rescaled to the typical activation norm at that layer, 𝐯 = n ¯ ℓ ⋆ ​ 𝐫 ℓ ⋆ / ‖ 𝐫 ℓ ⋆ ‖ 2 \mathbf{v}=\bar{n}_{\ell^{\star}}\,\mathbf{r}_{\ell^{\star}}/\|\mathbf{r}_{\ell^{\star}}\|_{2} , where n ¯ ℓ ⋆ \bar{n}_{\ell^{\star}} is the mean ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm of residual-stream representations over calibration trajectories. We also compare with training-based Masked-LoRA ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , which trains rank-64 LoRA adapters restricted to the surviving weights, details in Appendix C.4 . Hyperparameters are tuned on a held-out OpenR1 split and evaluated on AIME-25, MATH-500, and LCB (Appendix C.4 ). blocks.en: Table 5 compares TGAS with training-free baselines. Consistent with our diagnosis, steering toward termination improves both termination and accuracy: averaged over benchmarks, TGAS improves over standard inference at every model-sparsity setting (by 1.3–3.7 points), and it raises termination in 16 of 18 checkpoint-benchmark pairs without lowering it in any. It also attains the best average accuracy among training-free methods in all six settings, although per-benchmark gains are often within one standard deviation and TGAS trails the strongest baseline in four of 18 pairs. Baselines support our diagnosis: Forced-Answer, which also intervenes on stopping, is competitive when its budget matches problem difficulty; No-Repeat suppresses surface repetition but often hurts accuracy, especially on code; and SEAL, which suppresses reflection in general rather than looping specifically, raises termination at the cost of accuracy in several settings.
blocks.zh: 表5比较了总协定与无培训基线。 与我们的诊断一致,向终止方向的方向可以提高终止和准确性:平均比基准值高,在每一个模型-均衡设定上,TGAS比标准推断值高(比1.3-3.7分),在18个检查站-基准对中,它提高了16个的终止,而没有降低任何基准值。 它还在所有6个环境的无培训方法中取得了最佳平均准确性,尽管每个基准的增益往往在一个标准偏差范围内,而且TGAS在18对基准中的4对中走出最强的基准. 基线支持我们的诊断:强迫答复(也干预停止)在预算与问题困难相匹配时具有竞争力;无重复(No-Repat)抑制表面重复,但往往损害准确性,特别是在代码上;以及海豹突击队(SEAL)在一般情况下抑制反射,而不是具体循环,在几个场合以准确性的代价提高终止。

blocks.en: Table 7 shows that TGAS makes Δ cyc \Delta_{\mathrm{cyc}} more negative in all settings and substantially reduces decision points, roughly halving them at 60% sparsity ( 12.3 → 5.8 12.3\to 5.8 and 11.5 → 6.8 11.5\to 6.8 per 1k tokens for 7B and 14B, detailed in Appendix F.1 ). TGAS also reduces generation length by 7.6% on average across all sparsity levels, including the dense model, and by 12.3% at 60% sparsity (Table 6 ). These results support our hypothesis that TGAS reduces repetitive reconsideration (Section 3.2 ).

On DS-Qwen-7B, Table 6 shows that TGAS consistently improves accuracy across pruning methods, outperforming the pruned baseline in all eight settings and achieving the best accuracy in seven. It also restores termination on degraded checkpoints, improving both accuracy and termination, unlike No-Repeat, which often trades accuracy for termination. At 60% sparsity, where RAC- and Wanda-pruned models retain little accuracy, all training-free methods remain far below the dense model (Appendix F.6 , which also covers other models). Thus, TGAS transfers across pruning algorithms and calibration sets, provided the pruned model retains sufficient capability.
blocks.zh: 在DS-Quen-7B上,表6显示,TGAS不断提高各种穿插方法的精度,在所有8个设置中都超过了被穿插的基线,并在7个设置中达到最佳精度. 它还恢复了已退化检查站的终止,提高了准确性和终止性,与 " 不重复 " (No-Repeat)不同,后者往往以准确性换取终止。 在60%的sparsity,其中RAC-和Wanda-pruned模型保留了很少的精度,所有无训练方法都远远低于密集模型(Appendix F.6,它也涵盖其他模型). 因此,只要所铺设的模型保留足够的能力,TGAS就可跨出穿行算法和校准套件。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows that Masked-LoRA yields limited gains at 50% sparsity but substantially improves recovery at 60%, particularly on LCB, raising accuracy from 14.7% to 33.4% for DS-Qwen-7B and from 37.6% to 51.8% for 14B counterpart (Appendix E.2 ). This suggests that Masked-LoRA recovers capability lost to aggressive pruning. However, Masked-LoRA is trained on traces from the dense DS-Qwen-14B model, even for smaller models, confounding recovery with distillation. This contrast supports our diagnosis: under moderate pruning, much of the loss stems from failure to stop, which TGAS addresses without training; at higher sparsity, some capability is genuinely lost and can only be restored by updating the weights. Such recovery, however, requires a separate adapter and optimization procedure for each sparsity level and model.
blocks.zh: 图6显示,Masked-LORA的增收有限,为50%,但大大提高了回收率,为60%,尤其是低氯苯,使DS-Quen-7B的精度从14.7%提高到33.4%,14B对应的精度从37.6%提高到51.8%(附录E.2)。 这表明马斯凯德-洛拉公司恢复了因侵略性挤压而失去的能力。 然而,马斯克德-洛拉(Masked-Lora)接受了从密集的DS-Quen-14B型号上得到痕迹的训练,甚至对更小的型号也进行了训练,将回收与蒸馏混为一谈. 这种对比支持了我们的诊断:在中度挤压下,大部分损失来自未能停止,TGAS在没有经过训练的情况下解决了这个问题;在更高的痉挛度下,一些能力确实丧失了,只有通过更新重量才能恢复. 然而,这种恢复需要针对每个垃圾等级和模型制定单独的适配器和优化程序。

blocks.en: Figure 6 summarizes the ablations on DS-Qwen-7B (other models in Appendix F ). For Forced-Answer, reducing the reasoning budget consistently hurts accuracy, with 4K performing worse than 16K on both AIME-25 and LCB. For No-Repeat, 8-gram blocking is substantially more harmful than 32-gram blocking, particularly at 60% sparsity. For TGAS, increasing α \alpha consistently improves termination, especially on LCB, so α \alpha provides a controllable knob for balancing termination and accuracy. We also test TGAS robustness to the number of samples and checkpoint choice, finding that 50 samples per class suffice (Appendix F.5 ) and directions from different checkpoints of the same model remain effective (Appendix F.7 ). We also compare TGAS with Plan-CoT ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) and report significance tests with K = 16 K=16 on AIME-25 and LCB in Appendix F.9 and F.10 , respectively.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We find that under moderate pruning, a substantial and recoverable share of accuracy loss stems from disrupted termination rather than incorrect reasoning. As sparsity increases, pruned LRMs exhibit reasoning divergence: they often reach the correct answer and recognize where to stop under teacher forcing, yet fall into repetitive loops and fail to commit within the token budget. The hidden-state contrast between terminating and looping continuations is consistent across pruned checkpoints; building on it, TGAS steers pruned models toward termination without retraining, improving termination and accuracy across configurations. At higher sparsity, some capability is genuinely lost and can only be recovered by updating the weights, suggesting that future pruning methods should preserve termination behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,在中度干扰下,大量可收回的准确性损失来自中断的终止而不是不正确的推理。 随着筋疲力竭的加剧,Pruned LRM表现出推理上的分歧:他们常常在老师的逼迫下达到正确的答案并意识到该停止的地方,然而却陷入了重复循环,未能在象征性预算范围内承诺. 终止和循环延续之间的隐藏状态对比在被查封的检查站之间是一致的;在此基础上,TGAS引导被查封的模式走向无需再培训的终止,提高了终止和各种配置的准确性。 在更高的痉挛状态下,一些能力确实已经丧失了,只能通过更新权重才能被恢复,这说明未来的修剪方法应当保留终止行为.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our work focuses on post-pruning recovery and does not modify the pruning process itself. Thus, the proposed interventions recover degraded behavior after pruning rather than preventing it during pruning. Future work could incorporate these observations into pruning algorithms to preserve termination and reasoning behavior directly, alongside a more theoretical characterization of the relationship between pruning and reasoning dynamics.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作重点是后打捞恢复,并不改变打捞过程本身。 因此,拟议干预措施在破坏后恢复了退化行为,而不是在破坏期间加以预防。 未来的工作可以将这些观测结果纳入到平分算法中来,直接保留终止和推理行为,同时对平分和推理动态之间的关系进行更理论化的定性.

blocks.en: Following prior work on pruning LRMs ( Lucas et al., 2026 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2025 ) , we study unstructured sparsity; semi-structured patterns, which SparseGPT and Wanda also support, are a natural extension. All models are distilled or SFT-trained LRMs of at most 14B parameters, and the benchmarks cover mathematics and code only; whether the diagnosis holds for RL-trained reasoning models, larger models, or open-ended tasks remains open. Our analysis uses a 16,384-token budget, and TGAS requires sampling continuations from a pruned checkpoint once per model to construct the direction. Finally, TGAS targets termination; at high sparsity, where capability is genuinely lost, it recovers only part of the gap to the dense model.
blocks.zh: 此前曾研究过Pruning LRMs (Lucas等, 2026; Nguyen等, 2026; Ji等, 2025),我们研究了无结构的溅射;SparseGPT和Wanda也支持的半结构图案是自然延伸. 所有模型都是被蒸馏出或经过SFT训练的LRM,最多14B参数,基准仅涵盖数学和代码;诊断是否为经过RL训练的推理模型所持有,较大的模型,或者开放式任务仍然开放. 我们的分析使用16 384个基数的预算,而TGAS需要从一个被碾碎的检查站进行取样,每个模型一次才能建造出方向。 最后,TGAS的目标是终止;在能力被真正丧失的高度痉挛状态下,它只能将部分缺口恢复到密集模型.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work studies inference-time interventions for pruned reasoning models and does not introduce new data collection involving human subjects. The proposed methods can alter model generation behavior, including its tendency to terminate or continue reasoning; therefore, they should be evaluated for task-specific reliability before deployment.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了推论时间干预被推敲的推理模型,没有引入涉及人类主体的新数据收集. 拟议的方法可以改变模型生成行为,包括其终止或继续推理的倾向;因此,在部署之前,应评估其具体任务的可靠性。

blocks.en: A.1 Pruning Methods for Large Language Models
blocks.zh: A.1 大语文模型的运行方法

blocks.en: Pruning has long been explored as a means of reducing the computational and memory costs of neural networks while preserving model performance ( LeCun et al., 1989 ; Hassibi and Stork, 1992 ) . Recent work has extended pruning to large language models (LLMs), with methods broadly falling into unstructured weight pruning and structured architectural pruning ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) . For unstructured pruning, Frantar and Alistarh (2023) proposed SparseGPT, a post-training pruning method based on approximate second-order information that enables one-shot pruning of GPT-scale models without subsequent retraining. In contrast, Wanda ( Sun et al., 2024 ) estimates weight importance from the product of weight magnitude and input activation magnitude, providing a simple activation-aware pruning criterion without weight reconstruction or retraining.
blocks.zh: Pruning长期以来一直被作为在保留模型性能的同时降低神经网络的计算和内存成本的手段来探索(LeCun等,1989;Hassibi和Stork,1992.). 最近的工作已经扩展到了大型语言模型(LLMS),方法大致上属于无结构化的重量穿透和结构化的建筑穿透(Cheng等,2024年). 对于无结构的普跑,Frantar和Alistarh(2023年)提议了SparseGPT,一种基于大约二阶信息的训练后普跑方法,它使得一发一发的普跑GPT尺度模型无需后续再培训即可进行. 相形之下,万达(Sun等,2024年)从重量级和输入活性能的产物中估算出重量的重要性,提供了简单的活性-知觉穿透标准而无需进行重量重建或再培训.

blocks.en: For structured pruning, LLM-Pruner ( Ma et al., 2023 ) removes coupled structures according to gradient-based importance and subsequently recovers performance through lightweight fine-tuning. ShortGPT ( Men et al., 2025 ) instead identifies redundant transformer blocks using block influence and directly removes entire layers. Sheared-LLaMA ( Xia et al., 2024a ) further considers pruning layers and attention heads, followed by continued pre-training to recover the capacity of the compressed model. Kim et al. (2024) further shows that simple depth pruning can effectively compress LLMs while achieving comparable or superior performance to other post-pruning finetuning methods. Complementary work examines calibration data in post-training pruning ( Bandari et al., 2024 ; Williams and Aletras, 2024 ) . While pruning often uses small calibration sets, Ji et al. (2025) show that calibration choice substantially affects pruning quality, especially at high sparsity, and that self-generated data can be an effective alternative when pre-training data are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 对于有结构的普鲁纳,LLM-Pruner(Ma等,2023年)会根据梯度的分量去除偶联结构并随后通过轻量级微调来恢复性能. ShortGPT(Men等,2025年)取而代之的是利用块影响识别冗余变压器块并直接去除整个层. 剪接 LLAMA 游戏 (Xia等,2024a)还进一步考虑分层和注意力头,再继续预训以恢复压缩模型的能力. Kim等编. (2024)还进一步显示,简单的深度穿透可以有效地压缩LLMs,同时实现与其他后穿透后微调方法的可比较或优异性能. 补充工作审查训练后跑道的校正数据(Bandari等,2024;Williams和Aletras,2024)。 虽然普鲁恩经常使用小型的校准集,但Ji等人(2025年)表明,校准选择对普鲁恩质量有重大影响,特别是在高收缩度时,而且当培训前数据无法得到时,自发生成的数据可以成为有效的替代.

blocks.en: A.2 Pruning Methods for Large Reasoning Models
blocks.zh: A.2 大型理由模型的运用方法

blocks.en: Recent LRMs, such as DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) and Qwen3.5 ( Team, 2026 ) , introduce a distinct challenge for model compression. Unlike conventional LLMs, whose computation is often dominated by processing the input context, LRMs can generate long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories during autoregressive decoding. Consequently, preserving the input-to-output behavior alone may not be sufficient to preserve reasoning capability ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Recent studies have therefore begun to adapt pruning to the decode-dominated nature of LRMs ( He et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2024b ) . Lucas et al. (2026) show that conventional pruning can degrade reasoning performance and increase inference cost by inducing longer reasoning trajectories. They attribute this to the mismatch between input-oriented activation reconstruction and decode-time reasoning behavior, and propose Reasoning-Aware Compression (RAC), which incorporates both input tokens and on-policy reasoning trajectories.
blocks.zh: 近期的LRM,如DeepSeek-R1(Guo等,2025年)和Quen3.5(Team,2026年),为模型压缩带来了独特的挑战. 与常规LLMS不同的是,LRM的计算往往以处理输入上下文为主,而LRM在自发解码过程中可以产生长时间的思想链(COT)轨迹. 因此,仅保留输入对输出行为可能不足以维持推理能力(Chen等人,2026年)。 因此,最近的研究开始适应LRM的解码为主的性质(He等,2026;Xia等,2024b.). Lucas等 (2026年) 表明,常规普鲁斯可以通过诱导更长的推理轨迹来降低推理性能并增加推论成本. 他们将此归因于以输入为导向的激活重建与解码时间推理行为之间的不匹配,并提出了Reasoning-Aware Compression(RAC),它既包含输入符又包含政策上推理轨迹.

blocks.en: Complementing this direction, Wang et al. (2025) propose RESP, a self-reflective structured pruning framework that explicitly aligns pruning decisions with the reasoning dynamics of reasoning language models. Their approach uses self-generated reasoning traces as calibration data, decode-only gradient-based importance estimation, and progressive regeneration of calibration traces during pruning. Building on these findings, Xiang et al. (2025) argue that model-generated reasoning trajectories offer a more informative calibration signal for pruning LRMs than conventional human-written or generic language-modeling data.
blocks.zh: 作为这一取向的补充,王等(2025年)提出RESP,即自反式结构化的打压框架,明确将打压决定与推理语言模型的推理动态相配合. 他们的方法使用自发生成的推理痕迹作为校正数据,解码-只以梯度为基础的重要性估计,并逐渐再生穿行过程中的校正痕迹. 基于这些发现,Xiang等人(2025年)认为,模型生成的推理轨迹提供了比常规的人类写作或通用语言模型数据更丰富的校正信号来进行LRM穿行.

blocks.en: Beyond individual pruning methods, Zhang et al. (2026b) systematically investigate how different compression techniques, including pruning, quantization, and distillation, affect large reasoning models, with a particular focus on the components associated with reasoning degradation. Their findings suggest that compression can have distinct effects on memorization and reasoning, and that certain components, particularly MLP modules in later layers, play a disproportionately important role in preserving reasoning capabilities. Complementary studies on quantization further show that reasoning models exhibit distinct sensitivity to reduced numerical precision compared with conventional LLMs ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . More recently, Lotfi et al. (2026) investigate the overthinking phenomenon in quantized reasoning models, highlighting another potential consequence of model compression on the reasoning behavior of LRMs.
blocks.zh: 除了个人修炼方法之外 张等 (2026年b) 系统地调查了不同的压缩技术,包括平分,分解,分馏,如何影响大型推理模型,特别关注与推理退化相关的组件. 他们的研究结果表明,压缩可以对记忆和推理产生不同的影响,某些组件,特别是后层的MLP模块,在保留推理能力方面起着不成比例的重要作用. 关于量化的补充研究进一步表明,推理模型对数值精确度的降低具有明显敏感性(LLMs)(Liu等人,2025a.)。 最近,洛特菲等人(2026年)调查了量化推理模型中的过度思考现象,突出了模型压缩对LRMs推理行为的另一个潜在后果.

blocks.en: Final-answer correctness alone does not determine whether a model has successfully reasoned to the correct solution. In particular, a non-termination trace may contain the correct answer in its reasoning segment even though the generation never reaches the final-answer stage. We therefore introduce a separate answer-presence measurement that asks whether the reasoning process itself reaches or asserts the gold answer.
blocks.zh: 最后的回答正确性本身并不能决定一个模型是否成功地为正确的解决方案推理. 特别是,即使一代人从未达到最后的回答阶段,非终结的追踪也可能在其推理部分中包含正确的答案. 因此,我们采用了一个单独的答案-存在度测量,它询问推理过程本身是达到还是坚持黄金答案.

blocks.en: We therefore modify the extraction procedure to identify candidate values asserted throughout the reasoning trace, rather than extracting a single final answer, and evaluate each candidate using the same grading procedure. To account for the many intermediate numerical values in long traces, we define a hierarchy of increasingly permissive answer-presence criteria: • Explicit : an explicit answer in the think segment, identified by either a \boxed{} or \fbox{} expression matching the gold answer, or a statement of the form "the (final) answer is X X " or "Answer: X X " , where the remainder of the line is taken as X X . • Conclusive : an Explicit answer or an Assertion , where an Assertion is a sentence containing a conclusion cue, detailed "so", "thus", "therefore", "hence", "the answer", "which is/gives/means/equals", "we get", or "in total") whose text after the last copula with "is", "equals", "gives", "yields", "=" , or " ≈ \approx " matches the gold answer, following Lotfi et al. (2026) .

blocks.en: The nested design distinguishes explicit commitment from incidental occurrences. In particular, Conclusive is our primary answer-presence criterion, as it captures cases where the model reaches the correct result but fails to transition to a final answer. Figure 7 shows that many incorrectly graded traces nevertheless contain the correct answer with Explicit or Conclusive mentioned. At 60% sparsity, this occurs in 41.4 % 41.4\% and 39.2 % 39.2\% of non-terminating traces for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 7B and 14B, respectively. blocks.en: C.4.2 Forced-Termination Intervention.
blocks.zh: C.4.2 强制终止干预。

blocks.en: We investigate whether non-termination in pruned models can be mitigated by explicitly enforcing termination after sufficiently long reasoning traces. Our analysis shows that pruned models largely preserve both reasoning traces and the stopping mechanism of dense models, particularly at moderate sparsity, motivating this intervention. We therefore introduce a simple forced-termination intervention: given a reasoning trace, we append the </think> token to terminate the reasoning phase and then prompt the model to produce the final answer using an explicit pattern such as "Answer:" after D D generation budgets. This intervention prevents further free-running generation and directly tests whether the existing reasoning trace is sufficient to recover the final answer without modifying the model parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们调查在经过足够长的推理痕迹之后,能否通过明确强制执行终止,减轻在被磨损的模型中的不终止。 我们的分析显示,被挤压的模型在很大程度上既保留了推理痕迹,也保留了密集模型的阻断机制,特别是在中度痉挛时,这推动了这种干预。 因此,我们引入了一个简单的强制终止干预:只要有推理痕迹,我们就附上"/想"符号来结束推理阶段,然后促使模型使用D D 生成预算之后的"Answer:"等明确模式生成最终答案. 这种干预防止了进一步的自由运行生成并直接测试现有的推理跟踪是否足以在不修改模型参数的情况下恢复最终答案.

blocks.en:
SEAL ( Chen et al., 2025 ) is a training-free activation-steering method that
reduces redundant reasoning in LRMs. It segments a reasoning trace into
thoughts separated by \n\n and labels each
thought by keyword rules: a thought is a transition if it starts with "Alternatively" or contains phrases such as "another approach" , a reflection if it starts with "Wait" or contains phrases such as "let me check" or "make sure" , and an execution thought otherwise. SEAL finds that, for problems of comparable difficulty, incorrect responses contain more reflection and transition thoughts than correct ones. Since these thought types are separable in the representation space, SEAL constructs activation steering vectors to encourage desired reasoning behaviors, steering LRMs toward more execution thoughts.

由 \n\n 分隔的思维和标签

blocks.en: As sparsity increases, pruned models retain fewer problems solved by their dense counterparts, detailed in Table 13 , primarily due to increased non-termination rather than incorrect terminated generations, detailed in Table 14 . For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on AIME-25, non-termination rises from 9% at 10% sparsity to 73% at 70%, while terminated-wrong remains between 14% and 28%. This pattern generalizes across models and benchmarks with non-termination exceeding terminated-wrong rates in 10 of 12 pairs at 60% sparsity. Moreover, conditional on termination, larger models retain relatively high accuracy. For example, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B achieves 73.8% and 83.3%, while OpenThinker3-7B achieves 74.4% and 63.9% on AIME-25 and LiveCodeBench, respectively. These results suggest that pruning disproportionately impairs termination behavior, while the ability to reason correctly remains comparatively robust when generation terminates.

blocks.en: We investigate whether pruning alters reasoning trajectories at moments of reconsideration, where a model may either advance its solution or revisit previously explored reasoning. We define a Decision point as the start of a paragraph beginning with one of 11 reconsideration cues: wait , but wait , hmm , alternatively , actually , hold on , or let me check/verify/double-check/reconsider/re-check . Cues are matched case-insensitively at the beginning of \n\n -separated paragraphs, followed Lotfi et al. (2026) . The cue set is fixed beforehand using paragraph-initial bigram frequencies from dense-model traces and is not modified based on pruned generations. Control points are randomly sampled paragraph starts without these cues. We also assign each paragraph a local trajectory label: Cyclic if the Jaccard similarity between its set of 8-word n-grams and that of any preceding paragraph in the same trace is at least 0.5 0.5 , and Progress otherwise.

blocks.en: Section 4.2 shows that termination directions constructed from different pruned checkpoints of the same model have high cosine similarity. However, since these checkpoints are pruned from the same dense model, some similarity is expected regardless of what the directions encode ( Ding et al., 2021 ) . We therefore use hypothesis testing with three increasingly strong baselines and a transfer test to assess whether the observed cosine similarity is significant and specifically associated with termination.

blocks.en: Finally, we test whether the shared direction is functional. We split the branch points into five folds, keeping all continuations of a branch point in the same fold since they share a prefix. In each fold, we construct the direction of A A from four folds, project the held-out continuations of B B onto it, and compute the ROC AUC for separating terminating from non-terminating continuations, averaged over folds and layers. Setting A = B A=B gives each direction’s own AUC. As a control, we repeat the transfer with the labels of A A shuffled over 200 permutations. All directions achieve high within-checkpoint AUCs ( 0.914 0.914 – 0.991 0.991 ), while transferred directions on DS-Qwen reach 0.916 0.916 – 0.991 0.991 . Transfer AUC exceeds the 95th percentile of the shuffled-label control in 29 of 30 pairs. blocks.en: In conclusion, our results show that: (i) The cosine similarity of termination directions is consistently higher than that of all ablation baselines; (ii) Directions transfer across sparsity levels, consistently separating terminating from non-terminating continuations; (iii) These findings support learning one termination direction per model and reusing it across sparsity levels.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的结果表明:(一) 终止方向的同位素相似性始终高于所有终止基线;(二) 方向跨断层转移,始终将终止与非终止延续分开;(三) 这些结论支持学习每个模式的一个终止方向,并在断层层之间重新使用。

blocks.en: Tables 23 and 24 show that TGAS achieves the best or tied-best accuracy on 53 of 72 checkpoint-benchmark pairs, compared with 10 for Forced-Answer. It ranks first in 20 of 24 model–sparsity settings and outperforms Base in 22, with the mean gain increasing from 1.6 points on dense models to 3.7 points at 60% sparsity. For OT3-7B at 60% sparsity, TGAS improves LiveCodeBench and AIME-25 accuracy by 5 points each. TGAS underperforms Base on only 8 of 72 pairs, five on AIME-25. TGAS improves termination over Base on 65 of 72 pairs, including 51 of 54 pruned settings, with gains increasing from 2.6 points on dense models to 11.2 points at 60% sparsity. These gains generally translate into higher accuracy: among the 65 pairs with improved termination, accuracy increases on 53 and decreases on only 6. For example, on MATH-500 at 60% sparsity, TGAS raises termination and accuracy from 21.9% to 67.9% and 15.5% to 30.9%, respectively, for DS-Qwen-1.5B.

blocks.en: SEAL improves termination by a similar margin, 5.8 points on average, compared with 5.9 for TGAS and raises it on 62 of 72 pairs, but often at the cost of accuracy. Its accuracy is below Base on 40 of 72 pairs, including 33 of the 62 pairs where it increases termination, and its average accuracy falls below Base in 14 of 24 model-sparsity settings. blocks.en: Table 25 summarizes the results. At 50% sparsity, training-free methods match or outperform Masked-LoRA without additional training. At 60% sparsity, Masked-LoRA achieves stronger recovery, improving LiveCodeBench accuracy from 14.7% to 33.4% for DS-Qwen-7B and from 37.6% to 51.8% for DS-Qwen-14B, surpassing the best training-free results (19.5% and 42.9%). On MATH-500, it reaches 37.8%, 74.8%, and 79.0% for Qwen-1.5B, 7B, and 14B, respectively. These results reveal a trade-off: training-based recovery is more effective under severe pruning but requires optimization and a separate LoRA adapter for each sparsity level, whereas TGAS remains a competitive alternative without weight updates.

blocks.en: E.3 Headroom and Recovery Analysis
blocks.zh: E.3 总部和复原分析

blocks.en: Pruned models often fail to terminate even after their reasoning has already reached the correct answer. We ask two questions: how much accuracy would be regained if these generations simply committed to the answer they already state, and how many non-terminating generations TGAS actually turns into correct ones.
blocks.zh: 被推倒的模型即使推理已经达到正确的答案,也往往未能终止. 我们提出两个问题:如果这几代人仅仅致力于他们已经指出的答案,那么究竟会恢复多少准确性,以及有多少非终结的几代人TGAS实际上变成了正确的一代。

blocks.en: We evaluate DS-Qwen-1.5B, 7B, and 14B on 262 level 4-5 MATH-500 problems, from dense to 70% sparsity, using temperature 0.6 0.6 and a 16,384 16{,}384 -token budget. We define oracle accuracy as Base accuracy plus the fraction of non-terminating generations that already state the gold answer Conclusively (the same rule in Appendix C.2 ). For recovery, we measure the fraction of initially incorrect non-terminating and terminated-wrong generations corrected by TGAS on the same problems and seeds, and the fraction of Base-correct generations that remain correct.
blocks.zh: 我们对DS-Quen-1.5B,7B,14B的262级4-5MATH-500问题进行了评价,从密集到70%的斯波尔分量,使用温度为0.6和16,384 16{,}384-token预算. 我们把甲骨文精度定义为: Base精度加上非终结代中已经明确表示出金子答案的分数(附录C.2中相同的规则). 为了恢复,我们测量最初不正确的非终结和终止的错代数在TGAS纠正的相同问题和种子上的比例,以及仍然正确的Base正确代数的比例。

blocks.en: At 50% sparsity, the oracle is at most 2.6 2.6 points above Base (Table 22 ). Headroom grows under heavier pruning: committing to an already stated answer would raise DS-Qwen-1.5B at 60% from 15.5% to 32.6%, and DS-Qwen-7B and 14B at 70% from 21.9% to 43.7% and from 15.7% to 33.0%. TGAS captures 90% and 70% of this headroom for DS-Qwen-1.5B and 7B at 60%, exceeds the oracle for DS-Qwen-14B, and captures 82% and 37% for DS-Qwen-7B and 14B at 70%.
blocks.zh: 甲骨文的分数为50%,在基数上最高2.6 2.6分(表22)。 头室在更重的挤压下增长:承诺提供已经说明的答案将使DS-Quen-1.5B从15.5%提高到32.6%,使DS-Quen-7B和14B从21.9%提高到43.7%,从15.7%提高到33.0%。 TGAS以60%的速度捕获了DS-Quen-1.5B和7B的90%和70%的这个头室,超过了DS-Quen-14B的甲骨文;以70%的速度捕获了DS-Quen-7B和14B的82%和37%.

blocks.en: At 60% sparsity, TGAS turns 25.8%, 36.1% and 44.2% of non-terminating generations into correct ones for DS-Qwen-1.5B, 7B and 14B, against 17.1% (pooled over models) for a rerun of the unsteered model with another seed. In contrast, it does not help generations that terminated with a wrong answer: pooled over models, 31.2% of them become correct under TGAS and 31.9% under the rerun. TGAS therefore restores termination rather than correcting wrong answers, consistent with the intended behavior of its steering method.
blocks.zh: TGAS在60%的孢子时,会将25.8%,36.1%和44.2%的非终止代转化为DS-Quen-1.5B,7B和14B的正确代数,而17.1%(通过模型组合)用于用另一个种子来重播未成熟的模型. 与此相反,它无助于以错误答案结束的几代人:在模型上集合,其中31.2%在TGAS下正确,31.9%在重播后正确。 因此,TGAS恢复了终止而不是纠正错误的答案,这符合其指向方法的预期行为.

blocks.en: F.1 Behavioral Changes in Pruned Models After Steering
blocks.zh: F.1 引导后所驱动模型的行为变化

blocks.en: Section 3.2 showed that pruning makes re-treading increasingly competitive at decision points. Δ cyc = log ⁡ P ⁡ ( cyclic ) − log ⁡ P ⁡ ( progress ) \Delta_{\mathrm{cyc}}=\log P(\textsc{cyclic})-\log P(\textsc{progress}) , measured over the next 32 tokens after a reconsideration cue ( "Wait" , "Alternatively" , …), approaches zero as sparsity increases. blocks.en: Table 26 reports MATH-500 results for the three DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. TGAS makes Δ cyc \Delta_{\mathrm{cyc}} more negative in all 12 settings, with shifts of 0.7 0.7 - 3.4 3.4 . More consistently, it reduces decision points by 24%-56%, with the largest reductions at 60% sparsity: from 23.7 23.7 to 10.5 10.5 , 12.3 12.3 to 5.8 5.8 , and 11.5 11.5 to 6.8 6.8 per 1k tokens for the 1.5B, 7B, and 14B models, respectively. For the latter two, this restores reconsideration frequency to approximately dense-model levels. Overall, TGAS primarily suppresses repeated reconsideration and promotes earlier termination.
blocks.zh: 表26汇报了三个DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen模型的MATH-500结果。 TGAS使所有12个设置的 Cyc\Delta\ mathrm{cyc} 都更加负值, 班次为 0. 7 - 3. 4 3. 4 . 它更一致地将决定点减少24%至56%,最大的减少量为60%:从23.7 23.7降至10.5 10.5;从12.3降至5.8 5.8;从11.5 11.5降至6.8 6.8/克的1.5B、7B和14B型。 对后两种情况来说,这使复议频率恢复到大约密集的模型水平。 总体而言,TGAS主要压制了反复的复议并提倡更早的终止.

blocks.en: F.2 Ablation Study of Forced-Answer
blocks.zh: F.2 强迫答复研究

blocks.en: Table 27 shows that the effectiveness of Forced-Answer depends strongly on the generation budget. Short budgets can truncate useful reasoning in capable models, e.g., dense Qwen-14B drops from 54.2% to 25.0% on AIME-25 at D = 4,096 D=4{,}096 , while longer budgets are less effective for heavily pruned models. At D = 16,384 D=16{,}384 , forcing only at the token limit is generally safe but provides limited gains. Overall, no single budget works across models and sparsity levels. In practice, selecting D D requires estimating the difficulty of each problem, since a budget sufficient for difficult problems may unnecessarily truncate easier ones. This dependence on problem difficulty is a major practical drawback of Forced-Answer.
blocks.zh: 表27显示,强制答复的有效性在很大程度上取决于发电预算。 短预算可以在有能力的模型中截断有用的推理,例如:密集的Quen-14B在AIME-25上从54.2%下降到25.0%,D=4,096 D=4{,}096;而更长的预算对于被大量挤压的模型则不太有效. 在 D = 16,384 D = 16{,} 384, 强制只在象征性限度上一般是安全的,但提供有限的收益. 总体而言,没有任何单一预算在模型和抽筋水平之间发挥作用。 在实践中,选择DD需要估计每个问题的困难,因为足够解决困难问题的预算可能不必要地缩短困难问题。 这种对问题困难的依赖是强制答复的一个主要实际缺点。

blocks.en: F.3 Ablation Study of No-Repeat
blocks.zh: F.3 无重复研究

blocks.en: Table 28 shows that No-Repeat is sensitive to the blocked n n -gram size and that improved termination does not necessarily translate into accuracy gains. With n = 8 n=8 , accuracy drops across nearly all settings, including dense models, with particularly severe degradation on LiveCodeBench: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B falls from 73.2% to 19.5%, and the 7B model from 59.2% to 15.0%. Although n = 8 n=8 improves termination for heavily pruned 1.5B models and on LiveCodeBench, accuracy remains near zero in these settings, indicating that most additional terminations are incorrect. It also reduces termination for the 7B model on AIME-25 at every pruned checkpoint, from 43.3% to 35.8% at 60% sparsity.
blocks.zh: 表28显示,"不重复"对被封杀的n-克大小敏感,改进的终止并不一定会转化为精度增益. 在n=8n=8的情况下,精度在包括稠密模型在内的几乎所有设置中都有所下降,而LiveCode Bench上的降解尤其严重: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-14B从73.2%下降到19.5%,而7B模型从59.2%下降到15.0%. 虽然 n = 8 n = 8 改进了重推1.5B模型和LiveCode Bench上的终止,但这些设置中的精确度仍然接近于零,表明大多数额外的终止是不正确的. 它还将每个已关闭检查站的AIME-25型7B型机车的终止率从43.3%降至35.8%,为60%。

blocks.en: These results suggest that blocking short repeated spans can disrupt valid reasoning and code patterns. Increasing the block size to n = 32 n=32 mitigates accuracy degradation and preserves AIME-25 performance for most checkpoints, while improving termination at moderate sparsity, e.g., 39.2% to 70.0% for the 14B model at 60% sparsity. However, these gains yield limited accuracy recovery, and substantial degradation persists on LiveCodeBench, including for dense models. Overall, No-Repeat can suppress repetitive generation but does not reliably guide the model toward correct answers, making it the least effective of the three remedies.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,阻断短暂的重复跨度会打乱有效的推理和代码模式. 将区块尺寸提高到n=32n=32可以缓解精度退化,并保持了大多数检查站的AIME-25性能,同时改善了中度痉挛的终止状态,例如,14B型机车的终止率为39.2%至70.0%,为60%. 然而,这些收益的准确性恢复有限,LiveCode Bench持续严重退化,包括密集模型。 总体而言,"不重复"可以抑制重复生成,但并不能可靠地引导模型正确答案,使它成为三种补救措施中效果最差的.

blocks.en: F.4 Ablation Study of Steering Strength
blocks.zh: F.4. 指导力量的研究

blocks.en: Table 29 shows that the steering strength α \alpha provides direct control over termination, with stronger effects under higher sparsity. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B at 60% sparsity, LiveCodeBench termination increases from 1.8% at α = − 2 \alpha=-2 to 34.2% without steering and 57.9% at α = + 2 \alpha=+2 . On AIME-25, it similarly increases from 13.3% to 43.3% and 55.0%, respectively. The effect is smaller for dense and lightly pruned checkpoints, which already terminate reliably. Reversing the steering direction is particularly harmful: at 60% sparsity, LiveCodeBench accuracy drops from 14.7% to 1.1% when α \alpha changes from 0 to − 2 -2 . These results indicate that the steering direction directly affects the model’s stopping behavior.
blocks.zh: 表29显示,指导力为α-α提供对终止的直接控制,在高伸缩性下效果更强. 对于SeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B,在60%的斯帕分量下,LiveCode Bench的终止率从α=−2\alpha=-2升至34.2%而无向导;而α=+2\alpha=2. 在AIME-25方面,这一比例也从13.3%增至43.3%和55.0%。 对密集和轻微的检查站的影响较小,这些检查站已经可靠地终止。 扭转方向特别有害:当α-α从0变为−2-2时,在60%的螺旋时,活化系数(LiveCode Bench)的精度从14.7%降至1.1%。 这些结果表明,引导方向直接影响了模型的停止行为.

blocks.en: However, increasing α \alpha too strong beyond zero primarily improves termination rather than accuracy. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, positive α \alpha values produce little change in LiveCodeBench accuracy and even reduce the accuracy of AIME-25 at 60% sparsity: increasing the value of α \alpha from 1 to 2 reduces accuracy from 22.5% to 20%. OpenThinker3-7B exhibits a similar but weaker trend, with termination increasing modestly while accuracy changes only slightly. Overall, α \alpha is an effective control for termination, stronger steering mainly improves stopping behavior rather than solution accuracy, while reversing the steering direction can substantially degrade both.
blocks.zh: 然而,超过零的α-α过强主要改善终止而不是准确性。 对于DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B,正的α-α值在LiveCode Bench精度上产生很小的变化,甚至将AIME-25的精度降低到60%的平分:将α-α值从1到2将精度从22.5%降低到20%. OpenThinker3-7B呈现出类似但更弱的趋势,终止略有增加,而准确性仅略有变化. 总的来说,α-α是终止的有效控制,更强的指向主要能改善停止行为而不是溶液的精度,而倒转指向则能使两者都大幅降解.

blocks.en: F.5 Ablation on Number of Sampled Created Directions
blocks.zh: F.5 关于样本创建方向数目的规定

blocks.en: Table 30 shows that a small number of samples is sufficient to obtain an effective steering direction. Using 50 samples per class achieves comparable steering performance to 100 samples or the full set for both DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and OpenThinker3-7B. In particular, the termination rate remains stable across sample sizes: for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B at 60% sparsity on LiveCodeBench, it stays within 52.9%-57.6%, compared with 34.2% without steering. These results suggest that 50 samples per class provide sufficient signal to identify an effective steering direction.
blocks.zh: 表30显示少数样本足以获得有效的取向。 使用每类50个样本,可以实现与100个样本相可比较的向导性能,或者为DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B和OpenThinker3-7B两种样本的全套. 特别是,终止率在样本大小上保持稳定:在LiveCode Bench上,DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B的终止率为60%,其终止率保持在52.9%至57.6%以内,而无转向率为34.2%。 这些结果表明,每类50个样本提供了足够的信号,可以确定有效的方向。

blocks.en: F.6 Generalization Across Pruning Methods
blocks.zh: F.6. 贯穿整个运行方法的一般化

blocks.en: Table 32 shows that the termination failure is not specific to one pruning method. Under both RAC (SparseGPT) and C4-calibrated Wanda, the termination rate of Base drops monotonically as sparsity increases, for every model and benchmark. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B pruned with RAC, AIME-25 termination falls from 79.2% at 10% sparsity to 32.5% at 50% and 1.7% at 60%, and LiveCodeBench termination falls from 85.0% to 37.4% and 2.4%. The same trend holds for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B with RAC and for Wanda-pruned checkpoints. Accuracy degrades alongside termination in all cases.
blocks.zh: 表32显示,终止合同的失败并非仅针对一种挤压方法。 在RAC(SparseGPT)和C4校正的万达下,Base的终止率随着斯帕氏度的提高而单调地下降,每个模型和基准都是如此. 对于与RAC相通的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B,AIME-25终止率由79.2%的相扑性10%降至32.5%的相扑性50%和1.7%的相扑性60%;而LiveCode Bench终止率由85.0%降至37.4%和2.4%。 Depseek-R1-Distill-Quen-14B和Wanda-pruned检查站的趋势也是如此。 准确性在所有情况下都与终止同时下降。

blocks.en: TGAS remains effective under both pruners: it raises termination over Base on 16 of 18 checkpoint-benchmark pairs and improves accuracy on all 18, achieving the best accuracy on 15. The gains are largest where termination has collapsed, e.g., on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B with RAC at 60% sparsity, LiveCodeBench termination rises from 2.4% to 21.8% and accuracy from 2.4% to 13.4%, and on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B with RAC at 60% sparsity, AIME-25 termination rises from 21.7% to 47.5% and LiveCodeBench accuracy from 6.1% to 18.2%. Under Wanda, TGAS improves DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B at 50% sparsity from 47.5% to 64.2% termination on AIME-25 and from 31.8% to 39.2% accuracy on LiveCodeBench. These results indicate that TGAS recovers part of the accuracy lost to pruning by restoring termination, independent of the pruning method used.
blocks.zh: TGAS在两种推跑机下依然有效:它使18个检查站-基准对中的16个在基地上空终止,并提高了所有18个的准确性,使15个达到最佳的准确性。 终止率下降的幅度最大,例如,DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B的终止率为60%;LiveCode Bench的终止率从2.4%上升到21.8%;准确率从2.4%上升到13.4%;DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-14B的终止率为60%;AIME-25的终止率从21.7%上升到47.5%;LiveCode Bench的终止率从6.1%上升到18.2%。 在万达公司下,TGAS将DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B在AIME-25上以50%的螺旋性改进为47.5%到64.2%的终止,在LiveCode Bench上则由31.8%到39.2%的精度. 这些结果表明,TGAS恢复了部分精度损失,通过恢复终止而失去的精度,独立于所使用的精度方法.

blocks.en: F.7 Cross-Testing with Different Directions
blocks.zh: F.7 不同方向的交叉试验

blocks.en: TGAS constructs the direction at one sparsity level and reuses it across checkpoints. To test this choice, we construct additional directions at 40% and 60% sparsity for DS-Qwen-1.5B (default: 50%) and at 40% and 50% for DS-Qwen-7B (default: 60%), following Section 4.1 , and evaluate them on the dense, 10%, 50% and 60% checkpoints, selecting α \alpha using the same procedure on a held-out OpenR1-Math split. As shown in Figure 11 , all directions perform comparably: averaged over the eight benchmark-checkpoint settings, accuracy varies by at most 0.6 0.6 points across directions of the same model (20.4–20.9% for DS-Qwen-1.5B and 40.1–40.7% for DS-Qwen-7B), and termination by at most 4.1 4.1 points. Larger differences in individual settings appear only on AIME-25 (up to about 9 points for DS-Qwen-7B), whose 30 problems give standard deviations of 8–13 points. TGAS is therefore not sensitive to the sparsity level at which the direction is constructed, consistent with Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: TGAS将方向构筑在一个垃圾堆上,并经过检查站重新使用。 为了测试这一选择,我们为DS-Quen-1.5B(默认为:50%)和DS-Quen-7B(默认为:60%)设计了40%和60%的外接方向,并按照第4.1节,对密集、10%、50%和60%的检查站进行评估,在搁置的OpenR1-Math拆分中采用相同的程序选择α-α。 如图11所示,所有方向都具有可比性:平均在8个基准检查点设置上,准确度最多在0.6个0.6点上不同,同一模型的取向不同(DS-Quen-1.5B为20.4-20.9%,DS-Quen-7B为40.1-4.7%),终止率最多为4.1 4.1分. 单个设置中较大的差异仅在AIME-25上出现(DS-Quen-7B最多可达9分),其30个问题给出了8–13分的标准偏差. 因此,与第4.2节一致,TGAS对施工方向的相接性不敏感。

blocks.en: F.8 Comparison with SEAL
blocks.zh: F.8 与海豹突击队的比较

blocks.en: Table 31 compares TGAS and SEAL directions across layers and model families. All nine comparisons show weak positive alignment, with cosine similarities of 0.146–0.306 under Layer-mean averaging and 0.108–0.269 under Unit-avg averaging. Although alignment is slightly stronger for Qwen-7B and 14B, the results indicate that the two methods share only a limited directional component and are largely distinct.

blocks.en: To test whether SEAL is limited by building its direction on the dense model, we also construct its vector on the 50% checkpoint and tune it in the same way as the dense vector, selecting the steering layer and strength on the held-out OpenR1-Math split (Table 34 ). Averaged over the 16 settings of DS-Qwen-1.5B and 7B on AIME-25 and LiveCodeBench, accuracy changes only from 26.9% to 27.6%, with similar termination (65.9% and 64.9%). Both remain below TGAS (30.2% accuracy at 65.8% termination), which achieves the best accuracy in 14 of the 15 settings where any method scores above zero. The SEAL direction is thus stable with respect to the checkpoint it is built on, but steering away from reflection recovers less accuracy than steering toward termination.
blocks.zh: 为了测试海豹突击队是否通过在密集模式上构建方向来限制,我们还在50%的检查点上构建了它的矢量并用与密集矢量相同的方式来调节它,在被搁置的OpenR1-Math分裂上选择了方向层和强度(表34). 平均在AIME-25和LiveCode Bench上的DS-Quen-1.5B和7B的16个设置中,精度从26.9%到27.6%只有变化,类似终止(65.9%和64.9%). 两者都低于TGAS(30.2%的精度为65.8%的终止值),在任何方法得分高于零的15个设置中,14个都达到了最佳精度. 因此,海豹突击队的方向与它所建的检查站相比是稳定的,但从反射方向返回的准确性低于向终止方向的方向。

blocks.en: F.9 Comparison with Plan-CoT
blocks.zh: F.9 与Plan-CoT的比较

blocks.en: Plan-CoT ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) shows that LRMs plan their reasoning length before generation: question activations at the <think> position encode a direction whose magnitude scales with problem difficulty and the number of reasoning tokens. The direction is extracted by difference-in-means between hard and easy questions, 𝐫 ℓ = 1 4 ​ ∑ i = 2 5 ( 𝝁 ℓ , i − 𝝁 ℓ , 1 ) \mathbf{r}_{\ell}=\frac{1}{4}\sum_{i=2}^{5}(\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\ell,i}-\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\ell,1}) where 𝝁 ℓ , i \boldsymbol{\mu}_{\ell,i} is the mean layer- ℓ \ell activation at <think> over MATH questions of difficulty level i i , and is applied as 𝐡 ℓ ← 𝐡 ℓ + λ ​ 𝐫 ℓ \mathbf{h}_{\ell}\leftarrow\mathbf{h}_{\ell}+\lambda\,\mathbf{r}_{\ell} at every layer and token position; λ < 0 \lambda<0 shortens reasoning by raising the </think> logit. Plan-CoT therefore differs from TGAS in what the direction contrasts: it captures pre-generation difficulty planning, whereas TGAS contrasts post-branch continuations that terminate with those that loop.

We search λ ∈ { − 0.5 , − 0.4 , − 0.3 , − 0.2 , − 0.1 } \lambda\in\{-0.5,-0.4,-0.3,-0.2,-0.1\} and report the best value per checkpoint and benchmark. The selected Plan-CoT coefficient is either − 0.1 -0.1 or − 0.2 -0.2 , while the selected TGAS strength ranges from + 0.5 +0.5 to + 1.5 +1.5 .

blocks.en: F.10 Statistical Significance of TGAS Gains
blocks.zh: F.10 TGAS收益的统计意义

blocks.en: We evaluate TGAS against the base model on AIME-25 and LiveCodeBench (LCB) using DS-Qwen-7B and OT3-7B, with K = 16 K=16 samples per problem. The steering strength α \alpha is fixed using a held-out OpenR1-Math split. We assess significance using a two-sided problem-level sign-flip permutation test with 20,000 permutations. Pooled results aggregate the dense, OBC at 10%, 50% and 60% sparsity checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们使用DS-Quen-7B和OT3-7B对照AIME-25和LiveCode Bench(LCB)的基准模型来评价TGAS,每个问题有K=16K=16个样本. 转向力α-α使用被搁置的OpenR1-Math分出来固定. 我们使用两侧问题层的标志-滑动穿透测试来评估意义,使用2万个穿透. 集成结果使密集的OBC检查站达到10%、50%和60%。

blocks.en: Table 11 shows significant pooled accuracy gains in three of four model–benchmark pairs: DS-Qwen-7B on LCB (+1.5 points, p = 0.016 p=0.016 ) and OT3-7B on AIME-25 (+2.1, p = 0.046 p=0.046 ) and LCB (+1.1, p = 0.026 p=0.026 ). The largest checkpoint-level gains occur at pruned checkpoints, reaching +4.4 points for DS-Qwen-7B at 60% sparsity on LCB ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 ) and +5.4 for OT3-7B at 50% sparsity on AIME-25 ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ). The pooled gain for DS-Qwen-7B on AIME-25 is not statistically significant (+1.5, p = 0.171 p=0.171 ). For this pair, TGAS primarily affects termination behavior rather than accuracy (Table 23 ).

blocks.en: Shorter generations are only useful if they do not come at the cost of accuracy. Across six models, four checkpoints and three benchmarks, TGAS matches or exceeds the base model in 64 of 72 settings and raises mean accuracy from 46.5% to 49.1% (Tables 23 and 24 ). Both effects grow with sparsity: from the dense model to 60% sparsity, the mean accuracy gain rises from +1.6 to +3.7 points, while the token reduction rises from 4.4% to 12.3%, or 1,423 tokens per generation (Table 6 ). As pruning makes non-termination more frequent, steering towards termination removes more wasted tokens and recovers more answers otherwise lost to the budget. Overall, TGAS makes pruned LRMs cheaper to run while keeping accuracy at or above the base model.
blocks.zh: 更短的几代人只有在不牺牲准确性的情况下才有用。 在6个模型、4个检查站和3个基准中,TGAS与72个环境中的64个环境的基数模型相匹配或超过基数模型,并将平均精度从46.5%提高到49.1%(表23和24)。 这两种效果都随斯帕氏度而增长:从密集模型到60%的斯帕氏度,平均精度从+1.6升至+3.7分,而道具减少从4.4%升至12.3%,即每代1,423个道具(表6). 由于推跑使得不终止更频繁,转向终止会去掉更多被浪费的代币并收回更多本会失去预算的答案. 总体来说,TGAS使所运行的LRM更便宜,同时将精度保持在或高于基准模型.
